items.name: Superset Mobile
items.tagline: Your coding agents, now in your pocket
items.description: Orchestrate coding agents from your iPhone. Pick up the same workspaces from your computer, review diffs, and merge PRs away from your desk. Works with Claude Code, Codex, and other terminal agents. Included with Superset Pro. First month free with code MOBILELAUNCH.

items.name: Jev
items.tagline: Fast, structured AI decisions for software automation
items.description: Jev is TypeSafe AI's System One frontier model: unstructured state in, typed probabilistic decisions out. Instead of generating text, Jev returns Choice, Score, and Noul answers with calibrated probabilities your code can act on. Parallel sampling delivers ~70-500ms responses, about 20-200x faster and 40-400x cheaper than comparable LLM workflows, with output tokens free. Now available to everyone at console.typesafe.ai with no waitlist.

items.name: Arcjet
items.tagline: Secure the AI agents you're building at runtime
items.description: Arcjet is the runtime security platform that ships in your AI code. Detect prompt injection, authorize agent tool calls, redact sensitive data, and block bots and abuse. Real-time security building blocks you call inside your app, before an action happens.

items.name: Sai
items.tagline: The autonomous computer fleet at your command
items.description: Sai is the world's first robosecretary that works with a fleet of autonomous computers, doing your endless screen work. Each computer navigates software the way you do: reads the screen, clicks the button, types in the form. Trained to interact with the computer interface, Sai automates software even when they lack APIs: legacy desktop apps, internal portals, anything behind a login. Sai supports Windows, macOS and Linux. 73% on OSWorld.

items.name: Hyrax AI
items.tagline: The AI architect for your entire codebase
items.description: Code review tools tell you what’s wrong with a PR. Hyrax finds what should improve across your entire codebase and does the work. It builds deep context around your architecture and conventions, prioritizes issues across six engineering domains, writes each fix in context, verifies it against your tests and checks, and opens a GitHub PR for your team to review and merge.

items.name: Google Flow for iOS & Android
items.tagline: Google's AI creative studio now on mobile
items.description: Transform ideas into reality using Google’s advanced generative models for cinematic video, images, & tools, right from your phone. Use direct camera roll and live camera uploads to ground your image and video generations in your own personal experiences. It’s now easier than ever to pull inspiration from your camera roll or photos and videos captured in the moment. And with cross-device project syncing, you take your creative work wherever you go.

items.name: CC
items.tagline: Shared agent that helps keep your family in sync
items.description: CC is Google Labs’ shared AI agent for families and households. Up to six people can each choose what to share, then CC keeps everyone aligned on the day ahead and takes care of the small logistical work that usually gets lost between inboxes.

items.name: Sell to State
items.tagline: Search 3M government contracts in 64 countries
items.description: Structured government procurement data around the globe — tenders, suppliers and agencies. We help you research what governments around the world buy and find new opportunities to sell to them. No need to get a foreign company or e-signature before deciding there's money to be made. Browse for free; a flat fee unlocks the full dataset, saved searches, REST API and MCP.

items.name: AI Creative Insights by Decode
items.tagline: Predict which ad wins before you spend on media
items.description: Upload any ad, banner, OOH, or video creative and AI Creative Insights predicts how people will respond before your media budget goes live. Get attention heatmaps showing where eyes land first, second-by-second emotion curves, and prescriptive suggestions on what to change and why. Benchmark against category norms, compare variants side by side, and use Synthetic Audience to see predictions persona by persona. Built by Entropik, the team behind Decode.

items.name: Turfs
items.tagline: Keep content across your Mac organized in defined areas
items.description: Use the desktop to keep content from across your Mac accessible and organized in defined areas — or simply keep it clutter-free. A turf can be backed by a real folder, a Finder tag, or your hand-picked selection of files and folders. Turfs stay put through Show Desktop; you choose what Mission Control does with them. Quit, and the desktop is exactly as it was. It replaces Finder's own desktop icon layer, so it can never be sandboxed or sold on the Mac App Store. $29 once, 10-day trial, no card.

items.name: Flicka
items.tagline: Launch-ready product demos, from a Chrome extension
items.description: A screen recorder that makes launch-ready demos: auto-zoom on your clicks, backdrops, frames, a webcam layer, MP4 export. A Chrome extension; nothing uploaded.Flicka is now a Chrome extension. Record a tab, your screen, a window, an area or your camera; draw and blur on the page while you record. Your clicks become zooms in the editor, with captions made on your device. Nothing is uploaded.

items.name: Cronhq
items.tagline: Cron jobs that actually run
items.description: Cron jobs fail in silence. Two servers run the same crontab and your billing job fires twice. A job dies and nobody notices for weeks. Cronhq is a scheduler built around one guarantee: exactly-once execution, enforced by Postgres locks — not best-effort. Around it: retries with backoff, HMAC-signed webhooks, heartbeat monitors for jobs we don't run, and alerts that fire once on failure and once on recovery. Rust on Postgres. MIT-licensed, self-hostable, same image we run. Free tier: 5 jobs.

items.name: slop-grader
items.tagline: Jev-AI CLI tool that evaluates text against custom rulesets
items.description: slop-grader is a rule-based CLI tool that evaluates documents against custom rulesets and produces document scores and line-by-line flags to guide auto-fixing with an AI agent. Use it to catch AI filler in launch copy, to strip buzzwords from landing pages, score narrative flow in launch emails. Flagged lines let agents draft sharper copy. The tool flags outputs prompts so agents can draft fixes.

items.name: PostSider
items.tagline: Social media scheduling platform for humans and agents
items.description: PostSider is a social media publishing platform built for humans and AI agents. Schedule and publish content across 30+ platforms from one place, or connect Claude, Codex, Cursor, or your own agent through MCP, REST API, or SDK. Manage your content calendar, analytics, teams, approvals, and automation without juggling multiple tools.

items.name: Milliseconds.ai
items.tagline: Fast AI decisions on text and images, via one API
items.description: Text and images in. Labels, categories, structured fields and decisions out. Meet decision-machine-1, the small model behind milliseconds.ai. Route emails, extract invoice data, apply return policies (or build your hot-dog identification empire). One fast API. $0.04 per million input tokens. Output tokens are free. Get 125M free input tokens every month on test keys.

items.name: Gradio Workflow
items.tagline: connect nodes to build AI pipelines, powered by Hugging Face
items.description: Create AI pipelines by connecting nodes. Bring together Hugging Face Spaces, models, datasets, and your own Python functions on a visual canvas - or let AI agents build workflows programmatically. Inspect intermediate inputs and outputs, and swap in better models without rebuilding your workflow. No downloads needed! Share with a URL or run via a REST API.

items.name: Jevtown
items.tagline: 10,000 AI readers react to your post before you publish it
items.description: Write a post, a listing, a product or a headline, and 10,000 computed AI residents read it. The 600 it should matter to see it first, and it reaches the next 1,500 only if more readers were glad than annoyed, so a weak text dies for half a cent and a good one reaches everyone in 14 seconds. You get who stopped, liked, reposted or blocked, by interest, job, age, city and budget; the questions buyers would ask a listing first; and a demand curve over a product's price ladder. No sign-in.

items.name: Supacut
items.tagline: Quickly turn interview footage into a rough cut
items.description: Review hours of interview footage in minutes. Supacut helps documentary and interview editors find the strongest soundbites, organize material by theme, compare answers across interviews, and build a shortlist of selects. Or let Supacut analyze the material, propose narrative directions, and generate an editable rough cut. Export your work and keep editing in your NLE. Spend less time searching through footage and more time shaping the story.

items.name: Simha Digital
items.tagline: SEO workspace that tells you what to fix with a plan
items.description: Simha is an SEO workspace that tells you what to fix, not just what's wrong. Connect Search Console and Analytics, run a crawl — and get one health score, a plan ordered by traffic at stake, and an AI summary of what changed and why. Then the part no other tool has: we ask AI search engines your key queries and show whether ChatGPT-style answers cite your site, and who gets cited instead. Growth points, Core Web Vitals, an assistant that knows your data. 7 days free.

items.name: Plume
items.tagline: Import your old CV, get a polished ATS-ready one in minutes
items.description: Plume is a free resume builder that turns your old CV (PDF, Word, even a photo) into a polished, ATS-ready resume in minutes. Pick from 43 templates, fine-tune fonts, colors and spacing, check your ATS score and fix issues in one click. Export pixel-perfect PDFs with no watermark, even on the free plan. Pro (€4.99/mo) adds an AI assistant that tailors your CV to each job offer.
